findings.claim: The new `ReportIfLocatedInCompilation` filter drops every diagnostic whose location is null, and `GetPropertyIdentifierLocation` returns null for any source property not declared by a `PropertyDeclarationSyntax`. A positional record parameter such as `record Cmd([property: Key(null)] string Scope)` is declared by a ParameterSyntax. So the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull diagnostic for a property in the compiling assembly is now silently dropped. Base threw an InvalidCastException (AD0001) on the same input. The requirement only allows dropping location-less diagnostics for metadata symbols, not for source symbols.

It compiles the record with all MessagePack analyzers and expects a non-AD0001 diagnostic on the `[property: Key(null)] string Scope` parameter. On head no diagnostic is reported there.

findings.claim: The reporter named three unguarded `DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]` sites (issue lines 735, 1009, 1101). The hunks guard only the two property/member diagnostics (985, 1077). No hunk touches the first site, around base line 711-735 in GetObjectInfo. The generator path runs with a null reportDiagnostic, so `?.Invoke(...)` arguments are never evaluated there. If that first site indexes `[0]` outside a null-conditional invoke, the generator's CS8785 for `Item<T>` (record) struct from a referenced assembly may still occur. That would leave no resolver in app.dll.
